notes: Smarter card scan: job titles, office and factory addresses, and English names first
Multiple cards: swipe between a vendor's cards, newest first
Select text: copy any text right off a card photo
Scan a stack of cards at once: cards from the same company are grouped into one vendor
Vendor notes: write down what you remember about each vendor
Price in RMB: see the USD amount as you type, and convert with one tap
Photo text: search the words printed on your product photos
Faster, more reliable sync, even offline
Use Show Sourcing free: add up to 10 products and 5 vendors before starting a trial
Scan a stack of cards: cards from the same company are grouped, and you confirm before anything is saved
Vendor notes: write your own notes on any vendor; they sync and are searchable
Prices in any currency: type ¥32.50 and see ≈ $4.86; tap Convert to switch
LDP shows as many decimals as your prices
Select and copy text right off a business card photo
Category groups suggest which categories belong
Smarter card reading: job titles, office and factory addresses, English names first
Free plan: use the app without a plan for up to 10 products and 5 vendors, then start the free trial.
The words on every photo are read in the background, newest first. Opening a product reads it right away, and a new photo is read again.
Edits send only the fields you changed, so a teammate's change to another field is not undone.
Edits made with no signal upload when you are back online. Before, they could get stuck after 3 tries.
Business cards: English first for the company, contact name and address.
1.1.2 (6) - internal test
Spec tables on product photos: open a product with a spec sheet photo (e.g. a KY product), tap Redo on Text on the photos, and the specs show as a table.
Everything from 1.1.2 (5).
Card scan: vendor names drop the city (DongGuan jinghongxin Technology -> Jinghongxin), and an English company name wins over a Chinese one only when it looks like a real name.
Product page: Text on the photos, with Redo.
Everything from earlier 1.1.2 builds: Create lists scroll, Text from the card on vendors, the lag fix.
Product page: Text on the photos, its own card with Redo (re-reads the words on every photo).
Everything from 1.1.2 (3): Create lists scroll, English company names win over Chinese on cards, Text from the card on vendors, the lag fix.
Create: long vendor, category and tag match lists scroll now (the keyboard stays up).
Card scan: a Chinese name never becomes the vendor name when the card prints an English company name.
Vendor page: Text from the card, with Redo.
The app is smooth again (lag fix).
Vendor page: Text from the card shows what the card reader read, with Redo to read the card again.
Also in 1.1.2: the lag fix (the app is smooth again), smoother Filters, colored status flag, custom fields per category, Choice fields, QR codes from cards.
1.1.2 (1): the same as 1.1.1, now in App Store review, with the lag fix (a settings loop kept the app at 100% CPU).
Custom fields can show only for chosen categories (Settings > Fields > Show For).
New field type: Choice. Fill in the options; pick one with a chip.
Card scan reads QR codes: vCard, WhatsApp, website, email and phone fill empty fields.
WeChat and WhatsApp QR codes show on the vendor page. Tap to show full screen; hold to save to Photos.
Fast scroll: drag the right edge of Products or Vendors to jump through the list.
Card names: a card with English and Chinese names keeps the English name.
Small text on cards (like emails) reads better.
Card scan never adds a phone, email or WeChat that is not on the card.
Product grid: vendor gets the full line; narrow tiles show just the price.
Vendor pages open faster; smoother scrolling with large catalogs.
Spotlight and Siri search include custom field values and full vendor addresses.
Clear Local Data warns when items are not on the server yet.
Mac: status list from the flag (Cmd-S, arrow keys), comments pane on the right (Opt-Cmd-C), email (Shift-Cmd-E).
Deleting several card photos in a row removes the right card each time.
Merging vendors no longer leaves the old vendor behind.
Card photos no longer show twice.
Show Sourcing 1.1 is our biggest update yet.
Custom fields: add your own fields for the whole team, and search and filter by them.
Fields per category: show a field only for the categories it fits.
Choice fields: set the options once, then pick with a tap.
Card scan reads QR codes: vCard, WhatsApp, website, email and phone. WeChat and WhatsApp QR codes show on the vendor page.
Price breaks: a quantity price ladder for every product.
Price terms: FOB, CIF, EXW or DDP, with landed cost to match.
Export to Excel: products and vendors with photos in the cells and every field. We email you a link (paid plans).
Mac and iPad: products, vendors and settings side by side, with keyboard shortcuts.
AI Connection: connect ChatGPT or Claude to your catalog and ask about your finds.
US shipping records on vendor pages.
Photo descriptions: AI writes a short description of each photo (iOS 27).
Help & FAQ with search, and a What's New page.
Team statuses you choose.
Team Map shows who is at the same venue.
Faster camera with instant thumbnails and a zoom dial.
Prices and numbers follow your region's format.
Your display settings follow you to every device.
Every plan gets a team, so people you invite are covered.
Faster and smoother everywhere.
Card photos delete the right card, and merged vendors no longer leave a copy behind.
New devices get every product's details.
Photos no longer go missing after a delete.
Tariff nicknames: name an HTS code once ("Speaker") and every product in that category gets the official US rate, including Section 301 and the current country duty.
Tariff search in plain words: type "power bank" and find the right tariff line.
Category groups: group categories (even groups inside groups) and filter Products by a whole family.
Text on product photos is read and searchable, with Chinese translated to English.
Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your catalog (read-only) from Settings.
Ask Siri to find a product in Show Sourcing.
US customs shipping history on vendor pages.
Redesigned Create, Edit and Filters with clearer cards and larger labels.
One badge shows and switches the category-tariff link.
New "Tariff not linked" filter.
Grid shows status as a color dot; the filter icon fills when filters are on.
Tariff rates now refresh reliably, and country rates match current US rules.
Settings no longer shows a double Back button.
Subscriptions stay in sync with payments.
Sign-up catches mistyped email domains.
Smoother initial sync — the app stays interactive while your catalog downloads (no more freeze on first sign-in).
Catalog rows on smaller iPhones now show LDP clearly instead of the price wrapping under its label.
Faster vendor card scanning + better duplicate-vendor merging.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.
Fixed an issue where editing one product could overwrite or blank another product's vendor.
Faster business card scanning with improved accuracy on multi-photo vendors.
Better duplicate-vendor merging — no more leftover ghosts after merging.

Catalog title shows product count with a filter indicator when filters are active

Products sorted by newest first by default
